instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='contact-submit-btn', data-testid='timeline-node-0', data-testid='coffee-tip-5').
Implement the sticky hero canvas: 200vh parent div with a sticky top-0 h-screen container holding the canvas and overlay text.
Calculate scroll progress within hero [0, 1] to drive text scale down & opacity fade out (0-0.4), and canvas particle explosion (0.2-1.0).
Use Framer Motion or smooth state transitions for the horizontal section stacking / tabs.
Style all cards with delicate pastel borders (#E5E1DA), soft multi-layered ambient shadows, and rich backdrop blur.
Add interactive toast notifications using Sonner when submitting contact forms or sending virtual coffee tips.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: No dark default templates. Embrace the warm off-white cream (#FDFBF7) and rose/lavender pastel aesthetic.
Never use pure black #000000; use rich deep slate #1F2937.
Avoid Inter for main headings; use Cormorant Garamond / Serif typography for headlines.
Include data-testid on every button, tab, card, input, and modal trigger.
All forms must use customized Shadcn/UI or controlled input components with high contrast hover/focus states.
